description: This file contains the PHP class 'Coupon' which extends the system engine model class. The class provides methods to retrieve coupon data and related statistics from the database, including getCoupons() and getTotalCoupons() functions. The class is part of the OpenCart admin extension module for reports.

classes.name: Coupon
classes.description: Represents the coupon report model, providing methods to fetch coupon statistics and listing from the database.

methods.name: getCoupons
methods.description: Retrieves a list of coupons with their associated data filtered and paginated based on the input parameters.

methods.name: getTotalCoupons
methods.description: Returns the total count of coupons matching the provided filter criteria for pagination purposes.
